description: Phase 2: a 0.9 s windup that turns toward the giant (90 deg/s), then a committed run at 15 m/s with no steering for up to 6 s; against the arena wall or a pillar it forces boss_wall_recover (2.5 s), otherwise it ends in its own 1.4 s recovery. Its hit is the body_sweep: the king's capsule swept along the run. Unblockable and unparryable; a line telegraph along the committed direction; struck from at least 8 m from the giant's capsule (plan section 3.12).
